claim_boundary.note: The permutation is free on the value/BPW axes. Shipping it on the token path requires a LUT (or Gray) decode in the production kernel. This lane did not replace the shipped q = code - bound extract.

energy_claim.note: Energy is inferred from CMOS P = alpha C V^2 f. Only alpha is software-controlled here. No joule number is claimed.

fetch_order.gate_up_signs: row-major; one byte per 8 consecutive columns after alignment. simd/tg256 coalesce to sequential sign bytes of the row.
fetch_order.hgravs_codes: element = row*cols+col, 3-bit LSB-first extract. simd 32-wide tiles, 8 rows/TG. Packed bits are sequential in that element order.
fetch_order.not_file_layout: JSON envelopes are stripped before bind. Activity is on kernel-facing bodies.

next_bottleneck.what: down_proj two-stage factor matvec occupancy/dispatch, not switching activity
next_bottleneck.why: Q80 mixed is already known dispatch/host bound (~0.79% of 700-800 GB/s). A free alpha reduction does not move that wall unless the bus is contention-limited, which this GPU timing tests.

other_free_variables.bit_plane_msb_vs_lsb: free if extract matches; can change u32-word Hamming because 3-bit codes straddle words. Intra-word bit reversal of whole words cannot.
other_free_variables.gray_of_quant_levels: a specific assignment; reported next to the empirical optimum
other_free_variables.group_scale_packing: kernel fetches scales[element/group_size] in group-index order, which is storage order. Permuting storage and the index together fetches the same scale words in the same order, so activity is unchanged. Changing grouping would change values (not free).
other_free_variables.rice_symbols: not a free codebook; would change BPW
other_free_variables.sign_magnitude_vs_twos: also specific assignments of the same 3-bit alphabet; decode formula changes; values stay identical if the LUT matches

msb_vs_lsb_u32.note: MSB-first is free iff extract is also MSB-first. Intra-word bit reversal of whole words preserves Hamming; 3-bit codes straddle words, so MSB vs LSB can change u32 activity.

permutation.reason: Rice is a variable-length integer code for index diffs, not a centroid codebook. Permuting rice symbols would change bit length (BPW) or break the decoder. Residual signs are 1-bit; polarity flip is Hamming-invariant.
